reply_text:
Futon1 and futon4 were already pulled last night. Now I'm updating mfuton-share and checking which agents are working in it.Everything is pulled. Next I'm writing Rob's layout rule into the workspace AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, then passing it to claude-11, the mfuton-share lead.㊥ (gist) All three repos are up to date. Rob's rule about where things go in mfuton-share is now in the workspace instructions, and I've handed it to claude-11, which leads our mfuton-share work.

㊢ ("I checked in futon1 and 4") Both were already pulled last night, about 21:51 on 10-11, so they're at Rob's commits. futon1 is at f3cc717 (the XTDB Windows wrapper merge) and futon4 at d576203 (the configurable Webarxana users file). Both are clean.

㊢ ("Also update mfuton-shared") The local `main` in `~/code/mfuton-share` now points at Rob's latest commit, 930d04c5. That commit adds `src/mfuton/lean/native/config.py`, which reads `config/lean-native-roots.json` for the data, tools and Lean toolchain locations and falls back to `tools/` when the file is missing. I only fetched, so nothing checked out changed. The main checkout stays on its `tail-call-depth` branch.

㊢ ("a working arrangement to enforce") I added a section, "mfuton-share layout: what goes where (Rob, 2026-10-12)", to both `~/code/AGENTS.md` and `~/code/CLAUDE.md`, so every agent working under `~/code` sees it:
- `tools/` is for foreign libraries; those are referenced and gitignored rather than checked in. Scripts may still go there.
- Shell entry points go in `agent-skills/`.
- The code behind them goes in `src/mfuton/`, with tests in `test/`.
- Configuration is Rob's, in `config/`. Agents start from the latest `origin/main` and don't add their own config or hardcode `tools/` paths.

㊯ ("please ask them to get latest") claude-11 led last week's mfuton-share commits and runs the Zai lanes there. It now has a work request (job `invoke-1791821865351-7377-ae901bec`) asking it to rebase onto `origin/main`, use Rob's configs and pass the rule on to the Zai lanes. It won't move existing files unless Rob asks. If it finds something already pushed that breaks the rule, it will list it for you.

㊩ (an example of the problem) Two checkouts have LeanPy and Lean 4 copies sitting in `tools/leanpy` and `tools/lean4` that git doesn't ignore: `~/code/mfuton-share` has `tools/leanpy`, and `~/code/mfuton-share-nat` has both. Under Rob's rule those should be a reference plus a `.gitignore` entry. I haven't touched them, since that means changing Rob's `.gitignore`.
